title: Dosing Physical Activity Among Older Cancer Survivors Who Experience Chronic Pain: a Micro-randomized Trial
official: An Adaptive Design for Dosing Physical Activity Among Older Cancer Survivors Who Experience Chronic Pain: a Micro-randomized Trial
summary: The purpose of this study is to assess the best time to deliver a message to increase physical activity and how often participants will experience a pain episode in the 24 hours following their receipt of a message to increase physical activity.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Age greater than or equal to 65 years.
2. Patients with a history of bladder, breast, cervical, colorectal, endometrial, lung, and prostate cancer diagnosis and treatment.
3. Fluent in spoken and written English.
4. Patient has access to smartphone
5. Ability to understand a written informed consent document, and the willingness to sign it.

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Patient has metastatic disease.
2. Patient has cancer recurrence.
